mathAiIntro: I have been concerned by the rapid progress of artificial intelligence in recent times. Recent incidents should make it clear that, without timely intervention, the default outcome doesn't look good for humanity. But I am hopeful that if we hold on to our good-natured humanity, we can tackle this challenge and leverage the promise of this technology for the common good.

AI safety is an urgent challenge that requires ideas from all aspects of human endeavour. As a mathematician, I am exploring how I can contribute to the responsible development and use of AI. In this regard, I have been experimenting with AI for mathematics, with a focus on computation, formalisation, and AI safety. As I am new to this field, any mistakes here are entirely my own. I am continuing to learn and improve my understanding over time.

mathAi.title: LemmaPortfolio
mathAi.description: We developed a benchmark for selecting a small shared set of useful lemmas for multiple Lean goals. This work is part of our larger motivation to study how language models can assist a mathematician in theory building. The best tested GPT-6 Astra runs found an optimal three-lemma portfolio on only 50% of test episodes (30/60).

workInProgress.text: We are working on generalising the notion of a non-stationary dagger developed in our paper to chiral settings. Our main aim is to connect it to the literature on linearly distributive categories and thus to categorical semantics of quantum mechanics. Further work will explore applications of this framework to modelling concurrent quantum protocols.
